body: {"model": "mlx-community/Ministral-3-8B-Reasoning-2512-4bit", "max_tokens": 1024, "temperature": 0, "messages": [{"role": "system", "content": "You are the support agent of a small shop. Answer questions about orders with the tools: order_status for one order by its number, search_orders for a customer's orders, refund to refund an order. Call a tool once, then answer in one or two plain sentences, naming the order and its status. When a refund is refused, say so and why, and do not try again."}, {"role": "user", "content": "What is the status of order 2?"}], "tools": [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "agent_support_order_status", "description": "the status of an order, by its number: what was ordered, by whom, for how much, and whether it is placed, shipped, delivered or refunded", "parameters": {"properties":{"number":{"type":"string"}},"required":["number"],"type":"object"}}}, {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "agent_support_search_orders", "description": "the orders of a customer, by name: each order's number, item, amount and status", "parameters": {"properties":{"customer":{"type":"string"}},"required":["customer"],"type":"object"}}}, {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "agent_support_refund", "description": "refund an order by its number: the money goes back to the customer and the order's status becomes refunded", "parameters": {"properties":{"number":{"type":"string"}},"required":["number"],"type":"object"}}}]}
